highlighted.title: Intrastice v0.1
highlighted.subtitle: Next-Gen Ultra-Compact CoreXY
highlighted.description:
The planned 2nd generation of my custom CoreXY 3D printer series. A RepRap-ified Makerbot Replicator Plus, designed to be one of the world's most space-efficient 220mm³ CoreXY 3D printers. A direct successor to the Chimera iXY. 

Featuring a custom edge-ML vision system for real-time anomaly detection, fully enclosed (in final design), CPAP cooling, and much more. 

Features the unique compact Micro4 and ADXL345 FLY by Mellow, the Orange Pi Zero 2W, and a multi voltage power bus solution for adaptable fans. 

Very modular design, easily upgrade and replace components with a simple bracket.

highlighted.title: Chimera iXY v2.4
highlighted.subtitle: Custom High-Speed CoreXY 3D Printer
highlighted.description:
A fast 3D Printer using CoreXY kinematics, built from two different bedslingers; the Flsun i3 2017 and Mingda Magician X.

 Prioritized for reliability/speed, Chimera iXY achieves high-quality prints at MAX. 450mm/s and travel speeds up to 800mm/s.

Marlin/Klipper redy, 230mm^3 build volume, 10k mm/s^3 accel, 40mm^3/s flow rate.

Full documentation, 3D printable models, and firmware configurations are available for those looking to build their own hybrid machine. 

Current Status (2-21-26): v2.4 released; check the page for more details!
